review_comments.body: will conflict with every new pr adding a modular service.

I have not reviewed the overall to understand the big picture, but what I can tell you so far is:
1. Loading secrets into envvars make them available to children and some sibling processes (eg. `grep --text . /proc/*/environ`). See https://serverfault.com/a/1110351
So this sentence (already present before this PR) is problematic:
> Secrets should be added in environmentFiles instead of environment.

If the underlying software cannot consume its secrets securely, this is an issue.

2. Sourcing (with `.`) the environment file does not export the envvars to the wrapped program unless they're prefixed with `export` which they must not for `EnvironmentFile=`. Thus you may have to use some bash to `read` the names of the envvar and `export` them. Something like (not tested):
```done
while IFS='=' read -r n x; do test -z "$n" || export "$n"; done <${name}
```

3. There's a `lib.concatMapStringsSep`.
 
HTH
Thanks, will rethink the approach here. See what ghostunnel and others are doing.
